description: Save a barcode to QRdx, listed under Barcodes in the dashboard to edit and download later. Needs a QRdx API key with full access on this MCP connection (Authorization: Bearer qrdx_…); it saves to the key's workspace. Every plan saves barcodes (1,000 on Free). Takes the format and value generate_barcode takes, an optional title and options (foreground and background as hex, showText, barHeightMm, quietZone, scale, rotation).

folderId.description: A folder of the workspace by id (the codes' folders); null for none

format.description: The symbology: ean13, ean8, upca, upce, isbn, issn, ismn, code128, code39, code93, codabar, itf14, gs1-128, gs1-databar, gs1-databar-expanded, intelligent-mail, datamatrix, pdf417, aztec, dotcode (EAN-13 and UPC-A for retail products, ISBN for books, ISSN for magazines, ISMN for printed music, ITF-14 for cartons, GS1-128 for logistics labels, GS1 DataBar for a GTIN on small retail items, GS1 DataBar Expanded for a GTIN with a weight, price or date at the checkout, intelligent-mail for USPS letters and flats, Code 128 for your own labels, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec and DotCode for 2D)

options.description: How it's drawn; anything left out uses the format's defaults (black on white, the minimum quiet zone, scale 4)

barHeightMm.description: Bar height of linear barcodes in millimetres at the vector size (default depends on the format; Intelligent Mail is always 3.96 mm, the height USPS sets)

quietZone.description: Blank margin in modules: left and right of linear barcodes (up to 20), all round 2D codes (up to 10). Defaults to the format's minimum.

scale.description: Pixels per module in raster images (1-10, default 4; 2-10 for Intelligent Mail and DotCode)

showText.description: Print the digits or text under linear barcodes (default true; 2D codes have none)

title.description: A name to find it by, up to 100 characters (default: none; lists show the value)

value.description: The number or text to encode, checked against the format's rules. Retail and book numbers can leave the check digit off and it's added; ISBN, ISSN and ISMN take a 2- or 5-digit add-on after a space (an ISSN's 2-digit sequence variant comes first).

name: save_barcode
title: Save a barcode
